tools.name: reactions_list
tools.note: A person's own queue: the subject is taken from their credential, so `subject` is optional and may only name themselves.

tools.name: reaction_signal
tools.note: resume | retry | cancel | wake. The path parameters are arguments without being declared — the route cannot be called without them.

tools.name: whats_waiting
tools.note: PRD decision 42.2 — what is waiting IS flows: this subject's pending reactions, each naming the flow that produced it and its typed reason (human | failed | not_present | pending). Nothing is unioned at the edge. `auth: subject` means the person is the authenticated caller: flows resolves them from their own credential, and the tool takes no subject argument.
